summary: Iteration 13 Complete: Device-Ticket Integration Testing - All 12 backend tests passed, all 11 frontend features verified working
passed_tests: === Backend API Tests (12/12 passed) ===
GET /api/devices/dev-001/detail - returns device with 3 linked tickets
GET /api/devices/dev-003/detail - returns device with 2 linked tickets (TECH-SRV-01)
GET /api/devices/dev-005/detail - returns device with 2 linked tickets (HC-WS-REC01)
GET /api/tickets - returns device_id and device_name columns for linked tickets
GET /api/tickets - specific ticket for dev-001 has device_name='ACME-DC-01'
POST /api/tickets with device_id - creates ticket with resolved device_name
PUT /api/tickets/{id} with device_id - updates ticket and resolves new device_name
PUT /api/tickets/{id} with empty device_id - clears both device_id and device_name
GET /api/devices - returns 10 devices
GET /api/devices/stats/summary - returns total=10
GET /api/tickets - returns 16+ tickets total
GET /api/tickets - 15 of 16 tickets have device_id linked

Ticket statistics cards show correct counts: 3 Total, 2 Open, 1 In Progress, 0 Resolved

15 tickets show device name, 1 shows '-' (no device linked)

Create Ticket dialog has 'Linked Device' dropdown field (data-testid='create-device')

Device options show device name with OS and IP (e.g., 'ACME-DC-01 (Windows Server 2022 - 192.168.1.10)')
